excerpt.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
excerpt.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as

scope.zh: 已核对 astral_planes.3000–3170、50、3080、3099、situation_the_seal、astral_situation.10 / 15、solar_system_initializers 中的无形异使系统、相关 on_actions 与 scripted_effects；原先分散的 3010、3050、3065、3110、3120、3170、3000 等触发器故事已并入。未核对 timeline.65 与遗珍“永恒王座”的效果（不属于 C4）。
scope.en: Checked astral_planes.3000–3170, 50, 3080, 3099, situation_the_seal, astral_situation.10 / 15, the Formless system in solar_system_initializers, the related on_actions and scripted_effects; the formerly separate trigger stories (3010, 3050, 3065, 3110, 3120, 3170, 3000 and others) are merged. timeline.65 and the effects of the relic “Eternal Throne” were not checked (outside C4).

uncertain: “进度超过 95 且侵略者仍有舰队则停止增长”按脚本中 final_step − 5 < 进度 的条件转述。 / The “stops above 95 while invaders live” rule is paraphrased from the final_step − 5 < progress condition.
3100 的 75/25 随机中“加上已完成裂隙探索次数”按 modifier add = astral_rifts_completed 转述。 / The “plus rift explorations completed” on the 75/25 roll is paraphrased from modifier add = astral_rifts_completed.

三种异维度存在的名称（破界者 = Unbidden 等）取自 3110.e/f/g 的本地化；未核对国家类型 extradimensional_2/_3 的映射。 / The names of the three extradimensionals (Unbidden etc.) come from the localisation of 3110.e/f/g; the mapping of country types extradimensional_2/_3 was not checked.

note.en: 3100.d (non-homicidal empires without an overlord only): weight 75 (plus the number of rift explorations the empire has completed) succeeds → 3101, the Formless become a subject (preset_luminarium); weight 25 fails → hostility → 3102. 3100.e (demanding the Throne) leads straight to 3102 (war).

label.en: The Formless diplomacy window: three versions by progress and relation

note.zh: on_custom_diplomacy 依次检查（00_on_actions.txt:746-749）：3050 在封印尚未完成时对任何国家开放（可花 100 星界丝缕让其生成防卫舰队，至多 2 支）；3100 在封印成功后；3110 对已结盟者（索取奖励）；3170 对从未打开虫洞的国家（只能告别）。
note.en: on_custom_diplomacy checks in order (00_on_actions.txt:746-749): 3050 is open to any country while the Seal is not yet set (100 astral threads buy a defense fleet, at most 2); 3100 after a successful Seal; 3110 for allies (rewards); 3170 for countries that never opened the wormhole (goodbye only).

label.en: Which kind of extradimensional the allied leader meets

note.en: One by the enemy country type (extradimensional / _2 / _3); each fires only once and is pure narrative.

texts.zh:
这个虫洞的另一边似乎把我们带到了……星系的中心？

我们不应该存在于这里，更别说整个恒星系了。也许有一些维度操控在起作用吗？

我们没有太多时间来调查，因为我们正在接收来自一个未知实体的传输信号。
texts.en:
The other side of this wormhole seems to have taken us to... the center of the galaxy?

It should not be possible for us to exist here, let alone an entire system. Is there perhaps some dimensional manipulation at play?

We have little time to investigate, as we are receiving transmissions from an unknown entity.

notes.zh: 起点：任何舰队首次通过奇异虫洞进入“无形异使”星系，且是从水晶球星系过来的（on_entering_strange_wormhole，00_on_actions.txt:4144-4148；fire_only_once）。虫洞本身来自《晶体裂隙》中“打开传送门”的选择，或是水晶球星系天然存在的奇异虫洞（astral_planes.45）；本家族不重复那部分。
notes.en: Start: the first fleet of any country to enter the Formless system through the strange wormhole from the crystal sphere system (on_entering_strange_wormhole, 00_on_actions.txt:4144-4148; fire_only_once). The wormhole comes from the “open the doorway” choice in “The Crystal Rift” or from the natural strange wormhole of the crystal sphere system (astral_planes.45); this family does not repeat that part.

texts.zh: 这是什么……你带来了什么傻瓜来帮助你，沙达衮？或者……你给我们提供了食物……
texts.en: what is this... what fools have you brought to aid you, shadagon? or perhaps... you have offered us food...

label.zh: 我们被当作猎物，被诱惑到此地？
label.en: Have we been lured here as prey?

label.zh: 八支侵略者侦察舰队全部被击毁后（+2 天）
label.en: Once all eight Aberrant scout fleets are destroyed (+2 days)

texts.zh:
我们的舰队已经击败了守卫这个裂隙的奇怪船只，但似乎它们并不孤单。

我们收到了一段传输信号，来源于这个恒星系唯一行星旁边的建筑物内的存在。
texts.en:
Our fleets have defeated the strange ships guarding this rift, but it seems they were not alone.

We have received a transmission from beings inhabiting a structure nearby the lone planet in this system.

texts.zh: 更多的即将到来……我们必须封闭这个裂缝……我们是唯一剩下的人……
texts.en: more are coming... we must seal this rift... we are all that remains...

texts.zh: 星系中心的居民目前遭受一股未知势力的攻击，他们请求我们的帮助。如果他们失败，我们或许就再也无法知晓自己的命运。
texts.en: Under assault from an unknown force, the entities currently inhabiting the center of the galaxy have requested our assistance. Should they fall, we know not our fate.

sections.zh: 我们不进行干涉，任由冲突演变。
sections.en: We will let this conflict proceed without interference.

sections.zh: 如果我们将自己回收的星界丝缕交给这些存在，他们可以用它来加强自己的护盾。
sections.en: If we were to deliver our recovered astral thread to these beings, they could use it to fortify their shielding.

sections.zh: 异星天然气在这个存在的古怪泡泡中有放大效果。我们可以利用它来增强我们的武器。
sections.en: Exotic gases have amplified effects in this strange bubble of existence. We can use it to enhance our weaponry.

sections.zh: 我们必须消灭最后的入侵者，才能让无形异使正确地封印[Root.Target.GetName]恒星系。
sections.en: We must eliminate the last of the invaders for the Formless to properly seal the [Root.Target.GetName] system

label.zh: 若无形者的锚被摧毁（侵略者得手）：封印失败
label.en: If the Formless anchor is destroyed (the invaders win): the Seal fails

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个目标恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this target star system appears here.

notes.zh: 封印情境（单阶段，100 进度，每月基础 1）：不做事 −0.2、编织星界织物 +0.4（每月 10 星界丝缕）、注入奇异气体 +0.2（每月 50 奇异气体）；只要侵略者还有舰队且进度超过 95，就停止增长。每月脉冲 astral_situation.10：每 12 个月侵略者增援一支舰队（强度逐次 +1），无形者生成一支防卫舰队；每击毁一支侵略者舰队（astral_planes.3025）进度 +5。情境失败条件：开启者与无形异使敌对。完成后 astral_situation.15：消灭侵略者国家，在系统中生成盖亚星球（pm_formless_haven，3080 为其人口），解除奇异虫洞锁（所有玩家 1 天后收到 astral_planes.50），国家标记 the_formless_seal_is_set，再过 1 天触发 3099 → 3100。
notes.en: The Seal situation (one stage, 100 progress, base 1 per month): doing nothing −0.2, weaving astral fabric +0.4 (10 astral threads per month), pumping exotic gases +0.2 (50 exotic gases per month); growth stops while the invaders still have fleets and progress is above 95. The monthly pulse astral_situation.10: every 12 months the invaders reinforce with a fleet (strength +1 each time) and the Formless spawn a defense fleet; each invader fleet destroyed (astral_planes.3025) adds 5 progress. Abort condition: the opener becomes hostile to the Formless. On completion astral_situation.15: the invader country is destroyed, a Gaia planet is spawned in the system (pm_formless_haven, populated by 3080), the strange wormhole lock is lifted (all players get astral_planes.50 a day later), country flag the_formless_seal_is_set is set, and a day later 3099 → 3100 fires.

texts.zh: 最后……退位……我们的链条被打破……目睹我们的上升……我们将找到他们隐藏的东西……
texts.en: finally... abdication... our chains are broken... behold our ascension... we will find what they have hidden...

tooltips.zh: 被我们所知为无形异使的存在，已经被来自另一个位面的攻击者摧毁。位于亚梓拉士恒星系的传送门也被封印关闭。
tooltips.en: The beings known as the Formless have been destroyed by attackers from another dimension. The portal into the azilash system has sealed shut.

label.en: The Formless destroyed: the wormhole sealed

note.zh: 封印期间锚被摧毁：情境中止，无形异使被来自另一位面的侵略者消灭；开启者获得物理研究收入，其在该星系的舰队被撤回或摧毁，星系被摧毁，全局标记 strange_wormhole_closed。
note.en: The anchor is destroyed during the Seal: the situation aborts and the Formless are destroyed by attackers from another dimension; the opener gets physics research income, its fleets there are pulled out or destroyed, the system is destroyed and global flag strange_wormhole_closed is set.

texts.zh:
我们在[crystal_sphere_system.GetName]恒星系中发现的异常虫洞正在剧烈波动。传感器检测到它是通往星系中心的直接通道。

这怎么可能？
texts.en:
The anomalous wormhole we discovered in the [crystal_sphere_system.GetName] system is fluctuating wildly. Sensors detect it is a direct pathway to the center of the galaxy.

How is that possible?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在不断变化的状态下，这个实体的可见形态在这个现实和另一个现实之间转换。祂的声音共鸣如众多的和声，仿佛同时代表着几个存在。

……完成了……封印已经设置完毕……我们的孩子再也找不到这个地方了……
texts.en:
In a constant state of flux, this entity's visible form shifts between this reality and another. Their voice resonates as a harmonic multitude, as speaking on behalf of several beings at once.

... it is done... the seal is set... never shall our children find this place again...

responses.zh: 你知道我们……我们超越了裂缝……也属于裂缝……你已经见过了……
responses.en: you know us... we are beyond the rifts... and of the rifts... you have seen...

responses.zh: 我们的孩子……破碎的孩子……追捕我们……他们寻找王座……我们隐藏它……
responses.en: our children... broken children... hunt us... they seek the throne... we hide it...

responses.zh: 我们的永恒……我们的回忆……如果我们是血液……那就是心脏……现在安全了……我们感谢你……
responses.en: our eternity... our memories... if we are the blood... it is the heart... safe now... we thank you...

label.zh: 向我们臣服，你们将继续存活。
label.en: Serve under us, and you may yet still live.

tooltips.zh: 无形异使作为一个曙光境成为[This.GetName]治下的附属国。
tooltips.en: The Formless becomes a subject under [This.GetName] as a Luminarium.

label.zh: 将你提到的“王座”交给我们。
label.en: Give us this "Throne" you speak of.

label.zh: 盟友领袖的舰队日后与“破界者”交战时
label.en: When the allied leader's fleet later fights the Unbidden

label.zh: 结盟之后：通过外交窗口索取奖励（每 3600 天一次）
label.en: After allying: rewards through the diplomacy window (once per 3600 days)

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

notes.zh: 3100 是对话窗口：三个提问（你是什么 / 为何在此 / 什么是王座）只是对话，依次解锁；之后可 d 臣服（见互斥组）、e 索要王座（战争）、f 结盟（聘用领袖“乍狄伽”，设置 allied_with_formless 与成就标记）或告辞。它也由 on_custom_diplomacy 触发（00_on_actions.txt:747），要求国家带有 saved_formless 标记（astral_planes.3099 设置）且尚未选择奖励路径。
notes.en: 3100 is a dialogue window: the three questions (what are you / why are you here / what is the Throne) only unlock one another; afterwards d submits (see the exclusive group), e demands the Throne (war), f allies (hires the leader “zadigal”, sets allied_with_formless and an achievement flag) or you say goodbye. It is also fired from on_custom_diplomacy (00_on_actions.txt:747) and requires the country flag saved_formless (set by astral_planes.3099) and no reward path chosen yet.

texts.zh: 这已经被预测……我们会向你们称臣……这是我们的命运……
texts.en: this was predicted... we will serve you... this is our fate...

label.zh: 臣服成功：无形异使成为附庸
label.en: Subjugation succeeds: the Formless become a subject

note.zh: 创建新的“无形异使”国家（裂隙世界起源，民主），把盖亚星球交给它；获得遗珍“永恒王座”（r_eternal_throne），无形异使成为附庸（preset_luminarium）并获修正 pledged_allegiance，国家标记 allied_with_formless。
note.en: A new Formless country (Riftworld origin, democratic) is created and the Gaia planet given to it; the empire gets the relic r_eternal_throne and the Formless become a subject (preset_luminarium) with modifier pledged_allegiance; country flag allied_with_formless.

texts.zh: 我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
texts.en: we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

texts.zh:
永恒王座……轮不到你来取得……
我们误判了你……极度悲伤……让它结束吧……
texts.en:
the eternal throne... it is not yours to take...
we have misjudged you... great sorrow... let it be done...

label.zh: 战争中无形者的锚被摧毁时
label.en: If the Formless anchor is destroyed during the war

texts.zh: 我们针对无形异使的侵略行动，已经导致[this.GetName]放弃将舰队委任给我们，这些舰队重新加入他们的队列。
texts.en: Our aggressive campaign against the Formless has caused [this.GetName] to abandon their assigned fleets, and rejoin their ranks.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

note.zh: 对无形异使的敌意由 3150 隐藏事件落实：它设置 formless_war_state_initiated，生成 2 支 32 艘的防卫舰队并每 360 天再生成 24 艘一支（3151）；若盟友领袖属于攻击者，3155 令其离开（被解雇）。无形异使在敌人全部消失时自毁（3160）。
note.en: Hostility is enacted by hidden event 3150: it sets formless_war_state_initiated, spawns two 32-ship defense fleets and a 24-ship fleet every 360 days (3151); if the allied leader belongs to the attacker 3155 makes the leader leave (fired). The Formless destroy themselves when no hostile playable country remains (3160).

texts.zh:
我们已成功消灭了在[event_target:formless_system.GetName]中剩下的最后一批无形异使。

剩下的只有一个神秘的装置。一个人只需将自己的[this.species.GetHandNamePlural]放在上面，就能激活它神奇的再生特性。该装置作为一种通道进入星界位面，其中有大量的超维材料经由它自由流动。
texts.en:
We have successfully exterminated the last of the remaining Formless in [event_target:formless_system.GetName].

All that remains is a mysterious device. One need simply place their [this.species.GetHandNamePlural] upon it to activate its miraculous regenerative properties. The device functions as a sort of conduit into the astral planes, with incredible quantities of extra-dimensional material flowing freely throughout it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现一个身体部位的复数名称。
note.en: In the game, the plural name of a body part appears here.

label.zh: 无形者被摧毁（封印完成之后）

note.zh: 获得遗珍“永恒王座”与 1000 星界丝缕。
note.en: The relic r_eternal_throne and 1000 astral threads.

texts.zh:
沙达衮的乍狄伽……你怎么会在这里……

你将成为一顿盛宴……

来吧，与我们一同碰撞……
texts.en:
zadigal of shadagon... how is it you are here...

you will be a great feast...

come and break against us...

texts.zh:
我们还没有结束……沙达衮的乍狄伽……

你救了你的亲族……但愚蠢地追求……傲慢……

见证愤怒……然后是遗忘……
texts.en:
we are not finished... zadigal of shadagon...

you have saved your kin... but foolishly pursue... hubris...

witness fury... then oblivion...

texts.zh:
建筑师……沙达衮的乍狄伽……

我们将吞食你……吸收你的思维……

王座的秘密……你提供的伟大礼物……

现在加入我们……我们将尊重你……
texts.en:
the architect... zadigal of shadagon...

we will consume you...  incorporate your mind...

the secrets of the throne... a great gift you offer...

join us now... we will honor you...

texts.zh: 感激……安全……奖励……
texts.en: gratefulness... safety... reward...

responses.zh:
乍狄伽……永恒王座的建筑师……

祂花费了千年时间来制作……

一个将我们紧密联系在一起的装置……精致而永远……

它最适合为您服务……

再没有比您更聪明的了……
responses.en:
zadigal... architect of the eternal throne...

it is that one that spent millennia in its making...

a device to bind us as one... delicate and forever...

that one is best suited to serve you...

there are none left more clever...

responses.zh:
遗憾……

然而已经预见……

命运……

无需哀悼。
responses.en:
regret...

yet foreseen...

destiny...

do not mourn...

tooltips.zh: 将一支无形异使舰队交由你控制。
tooltips.en: Grants a Formless fleet under your control.

tooltips.zh: 获得一个随机物理学科技。

label.zh: 将你提到的“王座”交给我们。
label.en: Give us this "Throne" you speak of.

notes.zh: 盟友奖励窗口：每 3600 天可以在“力量”（一支 16 艘巡洋舰的舰队）、“知识”（一项随机物理科技）和“织缕”（100 星界丝缕）之间选一项；选择后 3111 在 3600 天后重新开放。另有三个提问（谁是破界者 / 背道者 / 暴烈者）→ 3114 → 3115（花 2000 星界丝缕获得针对该存在的修正 secret_of_the_unbidden / pacification_of_the_aberrant / folly_of_the_vehement）→ 3116。3110.d / h 只是关于领袖的对话。
notes.en: The allies' reward window: every 3600 days one of “power” (a fleet of 16 cruisers), “knowledge” (a random physics technology) or “fabric” (100 astral threads); after a choice 3111 reopens it 3600 days later. Three questions (who are the Unbidden / the Aberrant / the Vehement) lead to 3114 → 3115 (2000 astral threads buy a modifier against that being: secret_of_the_unbidden / pacification_of_the_aberrant / folly_of_the_vehement) → 3116. 3110.d / h are dialogue about the leader.

texts.zh:
沙巴纳什……破碎的亲人……永远饥饿……

我们的贪婪……被放大……

罪恶被揭示……

一个巨大的耻辱……
texts.en:
shabanash... shattered kin... hungry always...

our greed... amplified...

sins brought to light...

a great shame...

texts.zh:
达伽尔……无视……充满愤怒……

我们的愤怒……显现……

他们的冲突永远不会结束……
texts.en:
dagaal... heedless... filled with rage...

our wrath... manifest...

their conflicts will never end...

texts.zh:
盎宰……王座的追求者……

巨大的嫉妒……

我们被遗忘的概念……
texts.en:

# 无形异使 / The Formless

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`events/astral_planes_events.txt:1871–3496`（3000–3170）；`events/astral_planes_situation_events.txt:78–169`；`common/situations/06_astral_planes_situations.txt:357–525`；`common/solar_system_initializers/astral_planes_initializers.txt:2–260`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（全篇 whole story；原先分散的触发器故事 3000、3010、3050、3065、3110、3120、3170 已并入 / the former trigger stories merged in）

## 如何开始 How it starts

“无形异使”系统位于银河核心，只能通过水晶球星系里的奇异虫洞进入。虫洞来自《晶体裂隙》：选择“打开传送门”（1020.a → 隐藏 1095，国家标记 `opened_wormhole_to_formless_system`，全局标记 `strange_wormholes_locked`）。任何国家的舰队从水晶球星系第一次穿过虫洞时（`on_entering_strange_wormhole`），触发 `astral_planes.3000`“我们在哪”（只触发一次），随即 3005 侵略者（“背道者”）的传讯。

The Formless system sits at the galactic core and can only be entered through the strange wormhole in the crystal sphere system. The wormhole comes from “The Crystal Rift”: choosing to open the doorway (1020.a → hidden 1095, country flag `opened_wormhole_to_formless_system`, global flag `strange_wormholes_locked`). The first fleet of any country passing through it from the crystal sphere system (`on_entering_strange_wormhole`) fires `astral_planes.3000` “Where Are We?” (once), then 3005, the transmission of the invaders (the “Aberrant”).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 3000 → 3005：八支侵略者侦察舰队守在系统里（初始化时生成，各 5 艘）。
2. 击毁全部八支后 2 天，3015“信使”→ 3020 无形者的传讯：启动情境“封印”（`situation_the_seal`）。
3. 封印：单阶段 100 进度；每 12 个月侵略者增援一支舰队，无形者派出防卫舰队；每击毁一支侵略者舰队进度 +5（`3025`）；方法：不做事 / 编织星界织物（10 星界丝缕）/ 注入奇异气体（50 奇异气体）。侵略者仍有舰队时进度停在 95。
4. 完成 → `astral_situation.15`：侵略者国家被消灭，系统中生成盖亚星球，奇异虫洞解锁（所有玩家 1 天后收到 `astral_planes.50`），1 天后 3099 → 3100。
5. 3100：对话（你是什么 / 为何在此 / 王座）之后：臣服（→ 成功 3101 附庸 / 失败 3102 战争）、索要王座（→ 3102 战争）或结盟（聘用领袖，→ 外交窗口 3110）。
6. 战争（3150 隐藏）：无形者获防卫舰队，每 360 天增援；盟友领袖离开（3155）。无形者的锚被摧毁时 3165 给予遗珍“永恒王座”与 1000 星界丝缕。

1. 3000 → 3005: eight invader scout fleets (5 ships each) wait in the system.
2. Two days after all eight are destroyed, 3015 “The Messengers” → 3020 the Formless transmission: the situation “The Seal” (`situation_the_seal`) starts.
3. The Seal: one stage of 100 progress; every 12 months the invaders reinforce and the Formless send a defense fleet; each invader fleet destroyed adds 5 (`3025`); methods: do nothing / weave astral fabric (10 astral threads) / pump exotic gases (50 exotic gases). Progress stalls at 95 while the invaders have fleets.
4. Completion → `astral_situation.15`: the invader country is destroyed, a Gaia planet is spawned, the wormhole is unlocked (every player gets `astral_planes.50` a day later), and a day later 3099 → 3100.
5. 3100: after the dialogue (what are you / why are you here / the Throne): submit (→ success 3101 subject / failure 3102 war), demand the Throne (→ 3102 war) or ally (hire the leader, → diplomacy window 3110).
6. War (hidden 3150): the Formless gain defense fleets with reinforcements every 360 days; the allied leader leaves (3155). When the Formless anchor is destroyed 3165 grants the relic “Eternal Throne” and 1000 astral threads.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 封印失败：封印期间锚被摧毁 → 情境中止，3070：无形者被侵略者毁灭，系统被摧毁，虫洞封闭。
- 3101 臣服成功（权重 75，加完成的裂隙探索次数；25 失败）：新的“无形异使”国家成为附庸，遗珍“永恒王座”。
- 结盟（3100.f）：领袖“乍狄伽”（不朽、杰出级）；3110 每 3600 天可选力量（16 艘巡洋舰）/ 知识（随机物理科技）/ 织缕（100 星界丝缕）；还可花 2000 星界丝缕换取针对破界者 / 背道者 / 暴烈者的修正（3114–3116）。领袖遇上这三类存在时各有一次叙事事件（3121–3123）。
- 战争：见上；无形者在没有敌对的玩家国家时自毁（3160，若有强制友好者则只是停战）。

- Seal fails: if the anchor is destroyed during the Seal the situation aborts and 3070: the Formless are destroyed by the invaders, the system is destroyed and the wormhole closes.
- 3101 subjugation succeeds (weight 75 plus rift explorations completed; 25 fails): a new Formless country becomes a subject, with the relic Eternal Throne.
- Alliance (3100.f): the leader “zadigal” (immortal, renowned); every 3600 days 3110 offers power (16 cruisers) / knowledge (a random physics tech) / fabric (100 astral threads); 2000 astral threads also buy a modifier against the Unbidden / Aberrant / Vehement (3114–3116). The leader meets each of the three once (3121–3123), narrative only.
- War: as above; the Formless destroy themselves when no hostile playable country remains (3160; a forced-friendly one only stops the war).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 3100.d 臣服：仅限非狂暴灭绝者且无宗主。
- 3050（封印完成前，任何国家）：花 100 星界丝缕让其生成防卫舰队，至多 2 支；3170：从未打开虫洞的国家只能告别。
- 外交窗口版本由 `on_custom_diplomacy` 依次选择（3050、3100、3110、3170）。

- 3100.d submission: only non-homicidal empires without an overlord.
- 3050 (before the Seal is set, any country): 100 astral threads buy a defense fleet, at most 2; 3170: a country that never opened the wormhole can only say goodbye.
- `on_custom_diplomacy` picks the diplomacy window in turn (3050, 3100, 3110, 3170).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：上述事件与情境、无形者系统初始化（侦察舰队、国家变量）、`on_actions`（entering_strange_wormhole、fleet_destroyed_victim、custom_diplomacy、country_attacked、leader_death、entering_battle、country_destroyed）与 `schedule_next_formless_reward`（3600 天）。更正：编译器把 3000、3010（信使）、3050、3065、3110、3120、3170 各作为独立故事；现合为一个家族，补了 7 条桥接与 3 个互斥组。
- 不确定：三种异维度存在的名称与国家类型 `extradimensional(_2/_3)` 的对应取自 3110.e/f/g 的本地化；时间线事件 `timeline.65` 与遗珍“永恒王座”的效果未核对（不属于 C4）。

- Checked: the events and situation above, the Formless system initializer (scouts, country variables), the `on_actions` (entering_strange_wormhole, fleet_destroyed_victim, custom_diplomacy, country_attacked, leader_death, entering_battle, country_destroyed) and `schedule_next_formless_reward` (3600 days). Correction: the compiler had separate stories for 3000, 3010 (the messengers), 3050, 3065, 3110, 3120 and 3170; they are now one family with seven bridges and three exclusive groups.
- Uncertain: the names of the three extradimensionals and their mapping to country types `extradimensional(_2/_3)` come from the localisation of 3110.e/f/g; the timeline event `timeline.65` and the effects of the relic Eternal Throne were not checked (outside C4).
